data.body_html:
Planning a Marbella yacht charter for Feria San Bernabe 2038 is the smartest way to elevate your summer party. The Feria de San Bernabé, Marbella's biggest annual fair, takes place in early June and draws thousands to the fairground near the coast. Instead of fighting crowds all day, charter one of our boats from Puerto Banús for a few hours of sun, sea, and celebration. With prices starting at €749 for two hours (drinks and skipper included), it's an affordable luxury for groups of 5 to 12.

Why Combine a Yacht Charter with Feria San Bernabe?

The Feria is famous for its casetas, flamenco, and fairground rides, but the real Marbella experience happens on the water. A boat party gives you a private space to relax, swim, and enjoy the Costa del Sol coastline before heading back to the fair in the evening. Our marina is just a short walk from the Feria site, so you can easily transition from deck to dancefloor. Plus, with the Mediterranean averaging 24°C in June, the sea is perfect for a midday dip.

Our Fleet for Feria Boat Parties

We operate a range of motor yachts and speedboats from Puerto Banús. All include a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and 21% VAT. Here is a quick overview of our most popular party boats:

For larger groups, the Mangusta 80 (grey or white) offers a free jet ski and plenty of deck space. Smaller parties of up to 5 guests can opt for the Dubhe or Mariah SX21. All boats depart from Puerto Banús, a 5-minute taxi from the Feria.

What to Expect on Your Feria Boat Party

Every charter includes a welcome selection of drinks (water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava) plus light snacks. You can bring your own food, decorations, and a speaker for music. The skipper will take you along the Marbella coastline, past landmarks like La Concha mountain and the Golden Mile. Popular stops include Cala del Faro and Cala Cortés for swimming. Most charters last 2 to 4 hours, but we can arrange full-day trips (8 hours) on request.

Pricing and Booking Tips for Feria Week

Feria San Bernabe is one of Marbella's busiest weeks, so book early. Our Tier A boats (Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39) are the most affordable at €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours. The Mangusta 80 requires a minimum 4-hour charter at €4,719, which includes a free jet ski. For other boats like the Azimut 58 or Ferretti 94, pricing is available on request via WhatsApp. We recommend booking at least 2 months in advance for Feria dates.

How to Get from the Fair to the Marina

Puerto Banús is located just east of the Feria grounds. A taxi costs about €8–10 and takes 5 minutes. If you prefer to walk, it is a pleasant 20-minute stroll along the waterfront. This proximity makes it easy to schedule your boat party for midday or late afternoon, then return to the Feria for evening festivities. For a full day out, consider a longer charter that includes lunch and a sunset cruise.

Safety and What to Bring

All our boats are fully insured and equipped with safety gear. The skipper is licensed and experienced. Bring swimwear, sunscreen, a towel, and a jacket for the evening breeze. If you plan to swim, the water temperature in June averages 22–24°C. Glass bottles are not allowed on most boats, so use plastic or cans for any additional drinks. We provide coolers and ice.

Frequently asked questions

What is the best boat for a Feria San Bernabe party in 2038?

For a lively group of up to 12, the Mangusta 80 (24m) includes a free jet ski and departs from Puerto Banús. For smaller groups, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) at €749/2h is a great value choice with drinks and snacks included.

How far is Puerto Banús from the Feria San Bernabe fairground?

Puerto Banús is about 5 minutes by taxi or 20 minutes on foot from the fairground in Marbella. Our boats dock at the port, making it easy to go from the fair to the yacht.

What is included in the Feria boat party charter?

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden costs.

Can we bring our own food and decorations for the party?

Yes, you are welcome to bring your own food, decorations, and additional drinks (except glass bottles on some boats). Check with us when booking to confirm any restrictions.

What is the minimum booking duration for Feria week?

Most boats have a 2-hour minimum charter. For the Mangusta 80, the minimum is 4 hours (€4,719). We recommend at least 4 hours for a proper party experience.

How many guests can join a boat party for Feria San Bernabe?

Our fleet ranges from 5 guests (Dubhe or Mariah SX21) up to 12 guests (Mangusta 80, Azimut 58, Canados 86, Ferretti 94, K80, Maiora 26m). Choose based on your group size.

Do you offer evening charters for the Feria nightlife?

Yes, we offer charters at any time of day. Evening departures let you watch the sunset over the Mediterranean before heading back to the Feria. Contact us via WhatsApp for specific timings.

How do I book a yacht for Feria San Bernabe 2038?

Book via our WhatsApp number or use the contact form on our website. We recommend booking at least 2–3 months in advance for Feria week to secure your preferred boat and time slot.
